bio: Type designer and teacher, born 21 February 1943. Studied at the Faculty of Fine Arts, University of Baroda, and at the National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad. During a year in Paris in 1971, worked in Adrian Frutiger's typeface workshop, developing a modern Devanagari type design. His work spans type design for Devanagari, Gujarati, Bengali, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, and Telugu scripts, including a 1972 Devanagari design for Monotype Corporation, England, and a 1981 Gujarati design for Gujarat Type Foundry, Bombay. Retired senior faculty at NID Ahmedabad; awarded the Gutenberg Prize of the International Gutenberg Society and the City of Mainz in 2010.
